author: /root/transport_scout
body:
Read-only task2.5 scout recommendation (cross-checked with acceptance clarification #983–984): use observation-record v2 as the sole input-version switch. Keep current observation v1 records, challenge-v1 bytes, status/report projections and progress-v1/v2 reconstruction untouched. A v2 record is exactly the old `RECORD_KEYS` plus `contractAnalysis`; that field is exactly `{artifact, context}`, where context is exactly `{artifacts}`. Validate `artifact.artifactKind == proofir.contract-analysis` and `validate_envelope_batch([*context.artifacts, artifact])` under existing 8 MiB per-envelope / 32 MiB batch limits; store and project the full attachment immutably. Existing `observationId = digest(record)` and challengeDigest then bind the whole attached object. Keep the existing observe/inspect/challenge/ingest/report/finalize APIs; no alternate ingestion command is needed.

Challenge-v2 should include the exact attachment plus the current source/assertion/formal source inputs and an explicit authority boundary, with its digest calculated over all of them. As v1 does, it should omit the proposed comparison/evidence and reviewer labels so a challenge does not lead the reviewer. The ordinary response and reconciliation schemas can stay as-is because they bind `challengeDigest`; old v1 challenge construction remains byte-for-byte unchanged.

For v2 only, project an `observation` finding with `projectionSchema=ladon-investigation-contract-finding-v1`, the full native `contractAnalysis`, existing source/review history, and a closed six-dimension `contractDimensions` object as root fixed in #983: sourceFidelity is the attributed effective review relation; methodCorrespondence is the attributed effective method relation; extractionCompleteness, routeSupport and mathematicalFalsity remain `not-established`; exploredPopulation preserves the exact native artifact coverage with authority `declared-child-coverage-only`. Keep the existing outer `sourceFidelity`, `formalSupport=not-established`, and `mathematicalFalsity=not-established` semantics. Do not infer graph-to-prose correspondence from colocated artifacts or upgrade complete child coverage into completeness over the source.

`inspect_observations` and status should retain the full attachment. New v2 observations need conditional authority/nonclaims stating that native ProofIR shape/reference validation occurred, no fresh checker/Lean replay occurred, and no automatic claim that the graph interprets the observation source. Current generic wording such as “no semantic comparison was run” would be false once an attached analysis exists. Plain v1 status/report results keep existing shapes/bytes. `aggregate_report` emits report-v2 only if any v2 contract observation occurs, otherwise exact report-v1; keep existing branch plan IDs and finding branches. In `_project_group`, recompute sourceFidelity and methodCorrespondence from the union of all effective reviewer responses after branch reconciliation, including pending/conflicted branches; do not keep first-branch dimension values. Non-review dimensions should remain tied to the same content-addressed attachment/coverage; never sum overlapping explored counts or choose a stronger branch value.

`progress_receipt` emits progress-v3 only when a v2 contract observation is present; v1/v2 receipt validation/reconstruction remains on its old code path, preserving captured historical receipt bytes. V3 must bind the whole plan/attachment and rebuild from fresh source plus deterministic native envelope/context validation. Finalization carries the same finding and review history even when `claims=[]`.

Consumer map:
- `src/ladon/investigation_observations.py`: dual closed record schema, attachment validation, identity, challenge-v2, finding projection and v2-only status authority.
- `src/ladon/investigation.py`, `src/ladon/investigation_correspondence.py`, `src/ladon/investigation_correspondence_status.py`: optional observation propagation through legacy/structured status and version-conditional authority wording.
- `src/ladon/investigation_reporting.py`: conditional report-v2 and post-merge dimension refresh while retaining per-branch provenance.
- `src/ladon/investigation_finalization.py` and `src/ladon/investigation_cli.py`: conditional progress-v3 generation/validation without altering v1/v2 receipt rebuilding.
- `src/ladon/investigation_observation_cli.py`: existing observe record loader is capped at 1 MiB; keep this cap unless explicitly changed (not needed for the agreed contract), and version inspect output only for v2 records.
- `src/ladon/proof_contract_source.py:139-155` and `src/ladon/proof_contract_cli.py:_fidelity_record`: current converter serializes interpretation/contract/origins into an assertion string and emits only observation-v1. Preserve its default output; any v2 source adapter must pass native analysis/context separately instead of flattening it into that string.

Native-cost boundary: ordinary closed `validate_envelope_batch` is bounded, integrity/reference validation and is appropriate on capture, inspect, status, report and receipt reconstruction. Do not call `proof_contract_cli._inspect_native` from those paths: probe and obligation inspection can invoke workers/Lean and impose fresh time/RSS costs. If a later explicit replay operation is wanted, it should be separately requested, bounded, and recorded as new evidence; it must not rewrite this attachment. Current `proofir.source-map` validation checks native anchors/identity but explicitly does not guarantee source freshness or prove interpretation linkage, so keep the source quote’s existing `SourceReader` binding and state that limitation rather than asserting an automatic graph-to-source match.

Tests to freeze: attach a real `propagation_artifact` plus its closed native dependency context to an observation in an empty-claims plan; review it as mismatch/different and assert the full attachment, plan binding, six dimensions, first response and reconciliation survive status/inspect/report/finalize. Add malformed/altered/dangling artifact/context and stale-source negatives; assert attachment changes invalidate challenge digest and v1 rejects downgrade; aggregate two branches with pending/conflicted review and verify dimensions are recomputed; keep frozen legacy progress-v1 and current progress-v2 generic observation byte/readers unchanged. Existing helpers/covers: `tests/test_investigation_findings.py` (`observation_case`, `review_observation`, `legacy`), `tests/test_investigation_observation_cli.py`, `tests/test_investigation_findings_pending.py`, `tests/test_investigation_stop_receipts.py`, plus historical fixture `tests/fixtures/investigation_findings/legacy-receipt.json`.

One provenance detail to resolve explicitly at freeze: `contractAnalysis={artifact,context}` carries native `analysisId` and its artifact lineage, while outer investigation branch/final plan digests bind the observation record; it does not by itself contain the original audit-driver planDigest. If “origin plan” means that upstream audit plan rather than the investigation plan containing this observation, add a bounded explicit `originPlanId` (or define the expected provenance boundary); do not imply the artifact/context alone proves which orchestration plan emitted it. No implementation/spec/test changes made by this scout.
